purpose: Homepage hero lead paragraph — rotates monthly so the prose stays fresh for SEO freshness signals + the page never feels stale to repeat visitors.
rotation: Index = (year * 12 + monthIndex0) % variants.length. Same year+month always picks the same variant (build is idempotent). Each new month picks the next slot.
rules: 2 sentences, 30-50 words total — keep above-the-fold real estate tight.
No banned phrases per write-article/SKILL.md §1.2 — no 'guaranteed', 'risk-free', 'easy money', 'the only card', 'will definitely', 'proven', 'no risk', '100% sure'.
Sales-y but professional — sounds like a trusted comparison editor, not a hype reel.
